title: Integrated Shopify Commerce Site
desc:
I need a new Shopify store set up for a range of physical products and want it running smoothly from day one. The build should cover theme selection or light custom design, basic page creation, and the first batch of product listings so that I can focus on sales rather than setup.

Payments must flow through Razorpay and phone pe; those two gateways are non-negotiable for my local market. If you can wire in additional options such as PayPal, Stripe, or anything else Shopify supports without extra complication, let me know, but the priority is Razorpay and phone pe working flawlessly at checkout.

For fulfilment I rely on FedEx, UPS, and DHL. Their real-time shipping rates, label printing, and tracking updates have to appear inside Shopify and trigger customer notifications automatically. Please configure the carrier accounts, map shipping zones, and test end-to-end so I can book a shipment the moment an order lands.

I also want clean analytics from the start. Connect Google Analytics 4, Facebook Pixel, and Shopify’s own reports so I can see traffic, funnel behaviour, and conversion data in one place.

Deliverables  
• Live Shopify storefront with theme configured and core pages ready  
• Payment integration: Razorpay and phone pe fully tested in production mode  
• Shipping integration: FedEx, UPS, DHL, shiprocket, Delhivery with live rates, label printing, and tracking emails  which ever is most affordable 
• Analytics setup: GA4, Facebook Pixel, basic event verification

title: Instagram & LinkedIn Awareness Campaign
desc:
I’m launching a work-from-home opportunity and need a marketer who can raise its profile on Instagram and LinkedIn. Our priority is brand awareness, so every move we make—from the tone of the captions to the look of the graphics—must consistently tell the story behind the opportunity and position it as trustworthy and exciting.

Here’s what I’m after:  
• A short-form strategy that details how many text and image posts will go out each week, the themes they will cover, and the hashtags or LinkedIn keywords you’ll lean on.  
• Original copy and branded visuals for each post, optimised to feel native on both platforms while remaining recognisably “us.”  
• Scheduling and basic community management (liking comments, answering simple questions, flagging warm leads to me).  
• A simple performance snapshot every fortnight so I can see growth in reach, impressions, and any useful engagement trends.

I’ll supply brand colours, logos, and the core benefits of the opportunity; you bring the creative flair, the posting discipline, and the data-driven mindset. If you have previous wins building awareness on Instagram or LinkedIn—especially in the entrepreneurial or remote-work space—let me know.

title: B2B SaaS Outbound Specialist for AI Platform
desc:
Founding B2B SaaS Outbound / Enterprise SDR for AI Customer Experience Platform:
About XIFI / XARC

We are building XIFI, an early-stage enterprise AI customer-experience and communication platform being developed under the future company XARC Technologies, Inc.

XIFI is designed to help enterprises interact with customers through AI-driven communication channels, including real-time conversational AI personas. Our current MVP includes a working real-time video-avatar interaction experience, and we are now preparing for our first enterprise pilot/customer.

We are looking for one highly motivated B2B SaaS outbound / GTM freelancer to work directly with the founder.

This is not a traditional salaried sales position and it is not a VP of Sales role.

We are looking for somebody who is excited by the very early stage of a technology company and can help us build the first repeatable enterprise pipeline.

Your primary responsibility:

Your job is to create qualified enterprise conversations.

You will:

* Research and identify companies that match our ICP.

* Identify decision-makers in Customer Experience, Contact Centers, Customer Operations, AI, Digital Transformation, IT and Operations.

* Build highly targeted account/contact lists.

* Use LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, cold email, LinkedIn and other appropriate outbound channels.

* Personalize outreach instead of sending generic mass spam.

* Follow up consistently.
* Qualify interested prospects.
* Book qualified meet

title: High-Volume SIM SMS Blasts -- 2
desc:
I need to push more than 50,000 marketing SMS every day, Monday through Friday, and every single message must leave through an actual SIM on a GSM network—no online or grey gateways of any kind. The full recipient list is already cleaned and waiting in CSV; the text content is prepared and may include a few merge fields like name or coupon code that you will populate before send-off.  

You should already operate a modem or SIM bank large enough to reach roughly 12-15 k messages per hour, with automatic SIM rotation to avoid throttling or blacklisting. Accurate delivery receipts are essential so I can track campaign performance and handle any failed numbers.  

Deliverables  
• Daily proof-of-send file (MSISDN, timestamp, DLR status)  
• End-of-week performance summary (delivered / failed / blocked)  
• Written confirmation that all my data has been securely deleted after each cycle  

The campaign begins next week and will continue long-term if results stay strong. Let me know your hardware setup, network reach, and typical throughput so we can schedule a test batch right away.

title: WhatsApp Complaint Bot Setup
desc:
I need a developer who is already comfortable with the WhatsApp Cloud API to build, test, and deploy a small-footprint chatbot dedicated to automated complaint registration. The flow is straightforward: whenever a user sends a message that matches (or is prompted for) a complaint, the bot should gather the relevant details, hit our existing support-ticket API, and quietly confirm the ticket creation in the background. No sales, no FAQs, just this single automated response path.

What I’ll provide: the Facebook App credentials, webhook URL, and the endpoint documentation for our help-desk system.  
What I expect back: clean, well-commented source code, a short README covering setup and environment variables, and a live, working bot running on my Meta account. Whether you prefer Node.js, Python (Flask/FastAPI), or another language is fine as long as the solution stays within Meta’s Cloud API best practices and is easy for me to redeploy.

Milestone acceptance: I send a test message, the bot requests the complaint details, a ticket appears in the support system, and I see the chatbot’s confirmation on WhatsApp.

title: Exact Word-PDF Layout Conversion
desc:
I have several Microsoft Word documents that need to be turned into PDFs without a single shift in layout, spacing, margins, fonts, or embedded objects. Every page in the exported file must look identical to its Word counterpart—the brief is strictly “Keep the exact layout of the Word file,” so please approach this as a pixel-perfect job rather than a simple save-as.

You may use any reliable method—Adobe Acrobat, Word’s print-to-PDF engine, or specialized conversion software—as long as the final PDFs open flawlessly across common viewers and match the originals line for line. I’ll supply the Word files once we start; you’ll return the corresponding PDFs ready for distribution.

Deliverable:
• One high-quality PDF for each Word document, layout 100 % preserved.

To confirm accuracy, I will compare overlays and check fonts, image positioning, and page counts. If you are confident in producing mirror-image conversions every time, let’s proceed.

title: Authoritative Teenage Commercial Voiceover Needed
desc:
I have a short commercial in production and I need a confident, authoritative voice that still connects naturally with teenagers. The final spot will run primarily on social media, so the read has to be punchy, memorable, and instantly engaging for a Gen-Z audience while retaining the credibility of a professional brand voice.

What I already have:
• Final script in standard English, roughly 60 seconds  
• Storyboard with timing cues and mood references  
• Brand guidelines outlining pace, energy, and pronunciation of two trademarked terms  

What I need from you:
• A clean, broadcast-quality recording (24-bit / 48 kHz WAV plus a high-quality MP3)  
• Two full takes: one at normal pacing, one slightly faster for cut-downs  
• Light processing—noise removal and basic EQ—while leaving enough headroom for our mix engineer  
• A short pick-up session (up to 15 words) included in the fee, should wording or emphasis change after review  

Acceptance criteria:
1. Read meets the “Commercial” objective with an unmistakably authoritative tone.  
2. Delivery style resonates with a teenage demographic—no overly formal inflection.  
3. Audio is free of pops, clicks, and background noise, and peaks no higher than –3 dBFS.  

If this sounds like a fit, please send a brief sample—your existing reel is fine—as long as it demonstrates the authoritative style I’m after. I’ll move quickly on selection so we can get this spot wrapped and into post.
